research_method: Web search for recent GNN-based EEG seizure detection methods (2022-2026)
status: RESEARCH_COMPLETE — names and trends identified. NO direct experimental comparison performed. Published results on different datasets/protocols are NOT directly comparable.

candidate_methods.name: NeuroGNN
candidate_methods.description: Dynamic graph construction integrating spatial, temporal, semantic, and taxonomic correlations.
candidate_methods.reason: Different dataset (CHB-MIT vs Nasreddine). Different patient population (pediatric vs mixed). Cannot compare metrics without running on same data.

candidate_methods.name: Heterogeneous GNN
candidate_methods.description: Captures distinct functional roles of brain regions via heterogeneous graph types.
candidate_methods.reason: Different dataset. Reports accuracy ~98% on CHB-MIT which is not comparable to our precision/specificity on Nasreddine.

candidate_methods.name: HP-GNN (Hybrid Physics-Informed GNN)
candidate_methods.description: Combines data-driven learning with Kuramoto oscillator dynamics for chimera state prediction.
candidate_methods.reason: Different task formulation (chimera state prediction vs binary seizure detection).

candidate_methods.name: GCN-Transformer Hybrid
candidate_methods.description: Combines GCN for local inter-node relationships with Transformer for global feature aggregation.
candidate_methods.reason: Need to verify if evaluated on same dataset.

candidate_methods.name: Meta-GNN
candidate_methods.description: Meta-learning for rapid patient-specific adaptation with few samples.
candidate_methods.reason: Different training paradigm (few-shot vs standard supervised).

candidate_methods.name: EEG-GCA (Graph Correlation Analysis)
candidate_methods.description: Unsupervised anomaly detection for seizures without seizure training data.

candidate_methods.name: EEG-GNN (Wagh & Varatharajah, 2019)
candidate_methods.description: GNN for EEG classification with distance-based adjacency. Already cited in manuscript.
candidate_methods.reason: Different dataset. Already cited but not benchmarked.

larger_datasets_for_validation.name: CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database
larger_datasets_for_validation.feasibility: REQUIRES_CODE_AUDIT — need to verify if Colab pipeline can process CHB-MIT format
larger_datasets_for_validation.notes: Similar scale to Nasreddine (24 vs 22 subjects). Would demonstrate cross-dataset generalization.

larger_datasets_for_validation.name: TUH EEG Seizure Corpus (TUSZ)
larger_datasets_for_validation.feasibility: REQUIRES_SIGNIFICANT_EFFORT — very large, heterogeneous format, variable channels
larger_datasets_for_validation.notes: Orders of magnitude larger. Would be strong validation but may require significant code adaptation.
